title: Visualmente belo, clean, e bem efetivo. Uso o método PARA.
body: Pro método PARA, dos modelos que eu testei é um dos melhores, comparado com todoist, ticktick, dentre outros. Eu uso Projeto e Áreas nele, e Recursos e Arquivos no UpNote.
author: Eric Wendel

title: My life changed
body: This app literally changed my life. Just please, work to make everything shareable! I apply this app in my daily personal and work routine, but it would make everything even more perfect if I was able to share my plans and habits with loved ones AND WITH MY PEERS AT WORK OMG
author: yokiitos

title: The best productivity app for ADHD people
body: I’ve been using this app since its beta test, and I must say it is by far the best productivity app I've ever used, especially for someone with ADHD. You should give it a shot! You won’t regret it!
author: SalvingNothing

title: Amazing App
body:
